parsed_json.sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, act.standard_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_units FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN activities act ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1862' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY act.standard_value ASC LIMIT 500;
